note: Fallback meta layer. The bundled `meta` value on each hero in heroes.json is a tuned competitive baseline, not a measured pick-and-ban rate; ranks.json turns it into a per-rank number. When the public statistics API is reachable, live pick/ban/win rates for the selected rank replace this entirely and the data badge says so.

blend.note: How live rank statistics become a 0-100 meta score. pickRate/banRate/winRate arrive as fractions.
